name: units-show-field-descriptions
goal: Show documented input behavior including conditional defaults in units show.

evidence: ExplorerCatalogItems.label defaults to category or Other, but plain units show omits its documented behavior.
The standard render-unit test checks literal defaults but no field description, so a conditional default can disappear.
At a738cc9fd9 the standard render-unit case omitted the conditional default; red record 34967b8ea21a.
At 40753699dc each field description follows its typed row, preserving conditional defaults as prose.
The unchanged rendering test passed at 899ebe7358; matching red and green records are retained.
